verdict.rationale: AMD's own documentation lists Linux x86 64-bit as a supported OS for the RX 9070 XT. The ROCm 7.2.1 release documents Linux framework support for Radeon 9000 Series, including gfx1201 by name, and the ROCm installer bundles the amdgpu driver, so the documented Linux driver/stack release half is covered. The independent Linux testing half has no evidence: the only community items are TechPowerUp gaming reviews with no Linux content. missing for 10: independent hands-on Linux testing of this card, a dedicated Linux display-driver release history or notes, and open-source kernel driver details for this part.

support.subject: As a developer, Linux is a first-class citizen for this GPU — documented Linux driver releases and independent Linux testing of this part
